scope: The one prior test approved by the owner on 2026-11-15: test_process_memory.py::test_peak_reads_this_process_and_is_at_least_current. Reorder only: current_resident_bytes() is read before peak_resident_bytes(); the getrusage assertion and the peak >= current assertion are unchanged; no assertion weakened. Every changed prior test file is pinned byte-exact (1).
reason: The test read peak before current, so resident memory growing between the reads (xdist workers) made current exceed the earlier peak and failed the test (CI: assert 324612096 >= 324947968). A high-water mark read after current is always at least that current reading.
